chapter: Kid Rene, Chris Kelly and the bungalow
title: Five years at the West End bungalow
summary: After Desvignes, Bob Lyons and the Maple Leaf he joined Walter Decou's four-piece band at the bungalow for about five years.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Well, who did you play with after you played with Sidney Desmond?

With Sidney Desmond, I went with... I'm going to make some art out of it. I played with Bob Lyons then. Then I left Bob Lyons and went to the Maple Leaf Band. And then, after the Maple Leaf Band, I went to work at the bungalow. We played a dance at that, not the dance. Yeah, it was a dance. We called it a dance. And then, at the bungalow, I was playing with the Leap Leaf Band. And old man and I was doing for the prizes. He liked it in my drumming and he called me in the back. He said to me, he says, uh... Do you want some work here every night? I said, Bob, I would like to work here. I said, what do you pay? He said, well, you know, y'all don't pay much, but your tips are great. He said, my man's not getting no more than 24 dollars and a half a week. Well, I was doing during the time looking for depression. And that was big money, nothing like today. And we was making 75, 80 to 100 dollars a week this tip. So I said to him, I said, well, who's playing drum here? Well, I didn't know who was playing drum there. At that time, Bill Matthews was playing drums. It seems though that him and Bill had some kind of words. And he liked it my drum and he told Walter, he says, that night he made me leave my name and my phone number. And he told Walter, he says, Walter Dicku, he says, you go and see this fella at Big Garden. He tell him I wanted to come to work. So Walter came behind me and I went to work. I worked at the bungalow about five years. Made nice money out there.
Who all was in the band at the bungalow?

They had Willie Pajot. They had Walter Dicku, myself, and Sam Dutre, senior. Not junior, senior. Just four pieces, that's all we had. Can you tell me, did Lizzie Miles used to sing out there or not? Some place to stay in there? Well, Lizzie Miles was singing out there before I ever got out there. Before I got out there. Was that the bungalow or someplace else out there? It was someplace else out there. Not the bungalow. No. She was singing at the... We'll try to see her next week. We'll ask her all about that then. Yeah, I don't think it was at the bungalow. She was not there when I was there. But I know she was singing out there. I know she was singing out there. Yeah, I was wondering when she was there when you were... She was singing out there. But not the time that I was out there. Yeah.
